name: 22180 · Vienna, VA
findings: ZIP 22180 (Vienna) has 137 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22180 (Vienna) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22180 (Vienna) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
